reason: A passive observability plugin that records runtime session facts and aggregate statistics in local Markdown and JSONL journals without registering tools, making LLM calls, or injecting data into the agent.

summaries.zh: 一个被动式运行观测插件，将会话任务、模型、工具、失败、耗时和状态记录到本地 Markdown 日志及 JSONL 附件中。
summaries.en: A passive runtime observability plugin that records session tasks, models, tools, failures, durations, and statuses in local Markdown and JSONL journals.

capabilities: Records session task, model, tool, failure, duration, and status facts
Writes human-readable journal entries and JSONL sidecar data to a configured local file
Maintains aggregated session statistics and applies documented redaction rules
